days.scene: Compound interest 20% then p%, total 50%. Expose trap p=30, reveal p=25 via 1.2(1+p/100)=1.5.

days.hook: Why do SO many pick B?
days.scene: Linear word problem. Big arrows track the misread of 'at least' (>= not <=). Correct answer slides in.
Hard geometry: inscribed-angle question. 30 s ring timer. One-line shortcut reveal.

days.hook: 600 vs 800 scorer on the same question.
days.scene: Split screen. Left: 2 min algebra. Right: one Desmos line. Same answer, synced clocks.

days.hook: Stop solving this the long way.
days.scene: Overhead paper. Draw inscribed angle = half the arc shortcut, warm lamp lighting.
Overhead ASMR solve of a full SAT algebra problem. Boxed final answer. Lo-fi music only.
Series opener. Extreme-tier quadratic. 20-s solve. Blue 'Day 1' chip in corner. Template defined.

days.hook: Your Module 2 is decided before you finish Module 1.
days.scene: Two glowing doors (Easy/Hard). Score counter fills, Hard door opens at 15/22. Bridge line.

days.hook: Myth: you need to memorize geometry formulas.
days.scene: Reference sheet appears, formulas scroll. Then 4 you actually need: slope, vertex, %, exp growth.

days.hook: I'm a teacher. My students kept running out of real practice.
days.scene: Text+photo story, 3 beats: problem, what I tried, what I built.
R&W transition: however vs therefore vs furthermore. Countdown + colour-coded arrows reveal.

days.hook: Trap: the answer that LOOKS right.
days.scene: Percent: shirt $40 after 20% off. $48 crossed out. $50 boxed via 40/0.8.
Speed round. Shrinking bar. Score counter. Final 5/5.
Split screen 2 characters. Panicker guesses, Planner uses shortcut. Jump cuts.
Overhead paper. Bad parabola freehand, then vertex-form shortcut y=a(x-h)^2+k.
ASMR overhead solve of a trigonometry problem using the SAT reference sheet.
Series continues. New Extreme question, same template.

days.hook: I couldn't find unlimited hard SAT questions, so I built a tool for it.
days.scene: 10 s handwritten story then short honest screen clip of the question bank filtered to Advanced.

days.hook: 3 SAT words that keep showing up.
days.scene: Kinetic typography: ambivalent/mitigate/corroborate. Each with SAT sentence + Uzbek meaning.

days.hook: Everyone starts somewhere. My first practice test was a 1050.
days.scene: Calm desk, rain, yellow text. 3 beats: wrong, changed, happened. No app shown.

days.hook: Even top scorers get this wrong at first.
days.scene: x^2 + bx + 16 = 0 has one real solution. Trap b=4. Reveal b=8 via discriminant.
Probability question. Complement shortcut 1 - P(none) circled on paper.
f(a)=15 with f(x)=2x^2-3. You vs me layout. Reveal a=3.
Split screen same test. Left: no review. Right: 10 min review. Score bars.
Overhead paper: y=2x-1 and x+y=5. Add equations method. Point (2,3).
ASMR overhead solve of a reading-data question using the chart.
Series finale. Hardest one yet. Same template.

days.hook: You got this one right? Here are 50 more at your exact level.
days.scene: Medium question solved. Bridge line to Advanced-level unlock.

days.hook: The hardest SAT question ever written.
days.scene: Dark cinematic thriller: glitch cuts, deep bass. Dramatic voiceover reads slowly. Clean reveal.

days.hook: What happened when 20 students used adaptive practice for 2 weeks.
days.scene: Honest story, text + chart of avg point change. End 'season 2 starts tomorrow'.
